full_prompt_en: A square contemporary painted portrait shows a red-haired young woman before a dense backdrop of pale pink flowers and cool teal foliage. The flowers fill the frame from top to bottom, their many layered petals forming large rounded shapes around her head and shoulders. Darker green leaves and thin stems appear between them, giving the soft floral mass a clear underlying structure. The woman occupies the right half and turns slightly toward the viewer, with her gaze directed just left of the lens. Her auburn hair is swept back into a loose low tie, with a broad warm highlight across the crown and a few soft strands at the temple. Her pale face is modeled in cool mint-tinted light and gentle peach shadow. Wide green eyes, a small nose, and parted rose lips are rendered more precisely than the surrounding blossoms, drawing attention to her calm, questioning expression. A crisp white collared shirt frames the neck. Over it she wears a dark, almost black garment with a narrow ribbon at the throat; the deep value gives the luminous face and flowers room to stand out. A large bloom overlaps the left side of the head, while additional blossoms fill the upper right and the lower left edge. Light is soft and fairly even but slightly stronger from the upper left, brightening the forehead, cheek, flower petals, and collar without hard cast shadows. Visible strokes and faint textured grain remain in the petals and background, while the face is smoother and more carefully blended. The cool teal and warm coral-pink complement each other, and the dark clothing anchors the bright upper composition. No lettering appears. The overall image is intimate and decorative, balancing refined facial realism with broad floral color masses and softly painted edges.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形当代绘画肖像呈现一名红发年轻女子，身后是密集的浅粉花与冷青绿色叶丛。花朵从上到下填满画面，层层花瓣在她头肩周围形成大而圆润的形状。较深绿叶和细茎从花间露出，为柔软花团提供清楚的底层结构。女子占据右半幅，微微转向观者，目光落在镜头左侧。红棕头发松松束在脑后，头顶横过一道宽阔暖亮部，鬓边有几缕柔发。浅色脸庞由带薄荷色的冷光和温和桃色阴影塑形。宽大的绿眼、小鼻子和微张玫瑰色嘴唇比周围花朵画得更准确，把注意力引向平静而带疑问的神情。洁白衬衫领口围住颈部，外面是接近黑色的深色衣服，喉间系着窄丝带；深明度让发亮面部与花朵突出。大花覆盖头部左侧，更多花朵填满右上与左下边缘。光柔和且大致均匀，但左上方略强，提亮额头、脸颊、花瓣和衣领，不形成硬影。花瓣与背景仍保留可见笔触及细颗粒，面部更平滑且融合得更仔细。冷青绿和暖珊瑚粉互补，深色衣服稳定了明亮上部构图。画中没有文字。整体图像亲近且富装饰性，以精细面部写实平衡宽阔花卉色块和柔和绘画边缘。
style_prompt_en: Contemporary painted imagery pairs selective smooth realism with broad, softly faceted decorative marks. Cool teal, mint, and deep green form a field for blush pink, coral, and small warm reddish accents; the darkest value acts as a firm anchor beneath the lightest area. Large rounded masses repeat across the frame, while fine linear traces supply enough structure to keep them distinct. Focal detail is crisp and gently modeled, but surrounding forms remain looser, with visible strokes and slight granular texture. Soft upper-side illumination brightens pale passages without severe shadow, and cool reflected color enters adjacent light tones. Edges alternate between clear focal contours and painted transitions that melt into neighboring color. The composition is close and densely framed, yet the tonal hierarchy gives the eye a calm path through the ornament. The overall effect is tender, luminous, and quietly graphic, with warm-cool complementarity carrying much of the mood.
style_prompt_zh: 当代绘画影像把选择性平滑写实与宽阔、柔和切面的装饰笔痕结合。冷青绿、薄荷色与深绿作为灰粉、珊瑚色和少量暖红重音的色场；最深明度在最亮区域下方充当坚实锚点。大而圆润的体块在画面中反复，细线痕提供足够结构，让它们彼此区分。焦点细节清晰且温和塑形，周围形体更松，保留可见笔触和轻微颗粒。柔和的上侧光提亮浅色部分而不形成严酷阴影，冷反射色进入相邻的浅色调。边缘在清楚焦点轮廓与融入邻近颜色的绘画过渡间交替。构图亲近而紧密，明度层级仍给视线穿过装饰的平静路径。整体效果温柔、发亮且安静地具有图形感，冷暖互补承载大部分情绪。
theme_en: A red-haired young woman before large pale pink flowers
theme_zh: 一名红发年轻女子站在大片浅粉花前
name: Kris Knight
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
